If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in late horizon (day 25–30) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in mid horizon (day 15–24) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply from positive to negative within 5 days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% starting from day 10 onward.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.0–0.33) across 5+ days, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward bias in early horizon (day 1–10) to compensate for low confidence.  
If forecast deviates >3% from true value in early horizon (day 1–5), adjust next 3-day forecast by +0.5% if sentiment is positive, or -0.5% if negative.  
If true value drops >2% from prior day and sentiment is positive, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% in next 3 days to align with sentiment-driven correction.
